name: Grape Candy
source:
In order to protect his sister from witch's sacrifice, main character takes place of the sister and challenges the witch. However, he gets transformed in a half-human half-cat with very sensual body reacting to witch's punishment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了保护妹妹不被献祭给魔女，主人公代替妹妹成为祭品，亲自向魔女发起挑战。然而，他却被变成了半人半猫的模样，身体异常敏感，会不由自主地对魔女的惩罚产生反应。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
